finding: Current retention works only while the controller instance survives
observed: 05–08 and legacy steps use the same NativeWalkFlow values. No writes happen for unbuilt settings. Locale fetch deliberately keeps the same instance/data; WalkScreen key changes for city/saved/add and excludes locale. It also excludes accountSaved/source, though hydration depends on it.
requiredContract: Define normalized route scope including account/local saved source, exclude locale and transient return markers; no remount on locale/marker updates.

finding: Primary handoff currently exits rather than continuing
observed: S08 onExplore sets a completion flag and pushes another Hub. Return lands on the old step-2 interests grid.
requiredContract: New-draft cursor, direct confirmation→constraints transition; walking/tags retained elsewhere in same controller.

finding: Return identity is not reliable today
observed: Hub checks a flag and canGoBack only; this proves neither city, controller mount nor a correct target. Assistant fallback forwards only that flag.
requiredContract: Versioned transient return envelope + ephemeral live lease + exact native route key/city/mount matching; no params-only liveness proof.

finding: Absence, invalid storage and completed state are conflated
observed: read catches malformed JSON as undefined. loadCurrentWalk returns undefined for invalid schema, wrong city or finishedAt. I/O can throw. Hydration catch then switches to plan.
requiredContract: Classify slot observation before new-draft init. Unreadable/unexpected states enter recovery, never enable overwrite as if empty.

finding: Queued writes are not optimistic concurrency protection
observed: persistCurrentWalk serializes but writeCurrent can replace any existing slot. A different journey may appear during a mounted draft/build. Draft plan does not currently subscribe to slot changes.
requiredContract: Observe raw slot revision, recheck under the same existing mutation queue before committing new preview. Preserve current record on conflict; no last-write-wins generation.

finding: Saved opening is a replay and may replace current slot during hydration
observed: reopenSavedWalk resets execution and clears deadline; hydration then unconditionally persists its preview. Missing saved local IDs can fall into plan; account-open errors throw and catch also falls into plan.
requiredContract: Retain replay transform; handle requested-but-missing/account-failed separately. Do not silently replace a different current active/preview when opening a saved replay; retain both and present recovery/explicit existing replacement policy.

finding: Customize is a distinct existing planning mode
observed: customize keeps journey, changes stage to plan and hydrates fields from settings. Original manual/GPS provenance is not stored; it sets gps=settings.start and infers finish mode.
requiredContract: Do not replay 05–08 for explicit existing-walk Customize; preserve its edit lifecycle and coordinates without claiming a saved start is a fresh GPS fix.

finding: HH:MM alone cannot preserve a return-by calendar intent
observed: returnBy string survives Back, but deadlineForToday evaluates it on the current local date. After midnight, yesterday’s HH:MM could become a future time today.
requiredContract: Transient selected local day/time-zone metadata; day/zone change requires explicit time reconfirmation. Persist only existing absolute settings.deadline after Build.

finding: Build needs a synchronous single-flight/cancellation boundary
observed: build uses mounted guards and real layout/presentation waits but no initial build-specific ref lock. React rerender alone is not a double-tap guard.
requiredContract: One build request ticket, input snapshot, guarded commit and cancellation semantics; explicit Build only, no stale stage/record update.

finding: Controller Back paths are not one unified transition contract
observed: Android handler and Screen onBack use different numeric/flag paths. Plan step3 goes to repeated interests step2; edit origin is not represented.
requiredContract: One pure target decision called by both handlers, priority for current modals, explicit edit return and permission-attempt invalidation.

finding: Planner estimates are not pedestrian street routes
observed: measureWalk derives walking estimates from coordinate-to-coordinate distances and reserves a finish leg; deadline is future-today. Existing Start checks content/identity; it is not a guaranteed arrival-time replan.
requiredContract: Preserve existing walking-based estimates and explicit return choices. No street geometry, arrival guarantee, car/transit or automatic GPS completion.

finding: Account defaults cannot be repurposed as a guest draft store
observed: Guest loadTravelerStyle returns defaults; account style supports 60/90/120/180, while AvailableTime can select 240 and hydrate 90. Preference read failure falls back to defaults.
requiredContract: Account defaults initialize only after a genuinely safe new-draft decision; never replace retained draft or auto-save 240/deadline/GPS as account defaults.
